title: Cornell notes
audience: For students who take notes in class but never get round to turning them into questions.
description: Cornell notes your AI sets up for you: your notes on the right, a question for each on the left, and a short summary. Then it quizzes you.
tagline: Your notes, the questions, and a summary.
note:
Cornell notes

One section per lecture or chapter. Your notes go on the right, a question that each one answers on the left, and a summary of two or three sentences closes the section. To revise, cover the right column and answer the cues.

## Lectures

## Cues to revisit

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Cornell notes". Read it with fetch before each change. When I paste or dictate notes from a lecture or a chapter, add a section at the end of "Lectures" with edit: a "###" heading with the topic and the date, then a table with two columns, Cue and Notes. Put my notes on the right as short rows in my own words, and on the left a question each row answers. End with a line starting "**Summary:**", two or three plain sentences. When I say "quiz me", ask me the cues one at a time without showing the notes. Add any I miss under "Cues to revisit" as a checklist, and tick one when I get it right later.

asks: Here are my notes from today's economics lecture: …
Quiz me on supply and demand.
Which cues am I still missing?

args.new_string:
## Lectures
### Supply and demand, 1 October
| Cue | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| What shifts the demand curve? | Income, tastes, prices of related goods, expectations. A change in the good's own price only moves along the curve. |
| What is the equilibrium price? | The price where the quantity demanded equals the quantity supplied. |
| What does a price ceiling below equilibrium cause? | A shortage: at that price, people want more than sellers offer. |

**Summary:** Supply and demand meet at one price and quantity. Anything other than the price itself shifts a curve and moves that point; a price ceiling set too low leaves a shortage.

## Cues to revisit
- [ ] What shifts the demand curve?
- [ ] What does a price ceiling below equilibrium cause?

args.old_string: - [ ] What does a price ceiling below equilibrium cause?
args.new_string: - [x] What does a price ceiling below equilibrium cause?
